rcon.note_essentials: Items go through EssentialsX /give (not /i). Groups and permissions go through GroupManager (man*). Nickname only. Temporary entries work for permissions only ({node}|{period.duration}), units d/h/m, no seconds.
rcon.note_ftbranks: Modded ranks. Items use the vanilla /give. Nickname only. There are no temporary ranks, only permanent ones. Permissions attach to the rank, not the player.
rcon.note_luckperms: The most popular permissions plugin. Takes a UUID or a nickname. Duration is a string with units (30d, 1h30m); a bare number is read as an epoch, so we use {period.duration}. The group must already exist (lp creategroup).
rcon.note_pex: The classic permissions plugin. Nickname only. Duration is bare seconds ({period.seconds}).
rcon.note_powerranks: A rank plugin. Nickname or UUID. Temporary ranks use the expires:{period.duration} tag.
rcon.note_sponge: Items go through Nucleus /give (different argument order). Permissions and groups go through LuckPerms-Sponge.
rcon.note_vanilla: Items only. On 1.13+ NBT goes in {}, on 1.20.5+ components go in []. Nickname only, and the player must be online.
rcon.ph_duration: Duration as a string with units
rcon.ph_uuid: Player UUID (some plugins want it without dashes)
